name: Mac Mouse Fix
use_label: Add trackpad gestures to any Mac mouse
one_liner: Free macOS utility that gives a cheap mouse trackpad-style gestures — three-finger swipes included.

text.why: macOS gives trackpads great gestures but leaves mice out. Mac Mouse Fix lets any USB or Bluetooth mouse assign trackpad-level actions — Mission Control, Spaces, Smart Zoom — to its scroll wheel and extra buttons.
text.take: There are other mouse utilities, but this one has over ten thousand stars and a level of polish that mirrors Apple's own trackpad gestures closely.
build: A single preferences app that lives in the menu bar. A per-button mapping screen lets you assign click, scroll and drag actions, with adjustable smooth-scrolling and zoom sensitivity.

who.role: Mac users who want trackpad-level convenience from a cheap mouse, or who want mouse buttons mapped their own way.

start.text: Download the app from macmousefix.com, grant Accessibility permission when prompted, and assign actions in the Buttons tab.

caveat: The source is open but uses a custom "MMF License" — you may build on it, but any derivative must keep the same licensing/monetization code intact and can't be resold.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
